R1_MEASURE_FROM_SCENE_LINEAR.change: every texture axis reads the float EXR the renderer already writes, in scene-linear, RGB only. The 8-bit and mislabelled '16bit' PNGs are demoted to human review artifacts and are never a measurement input.
R1_MEASURE_FROM_SCENE_LINEAR.why_not_just_fix_the_png: a 16-bit PNG would still be display-encoded and quantised, and the EXR is already written on every render. Measuring the float frame removes the whole class instead of moving it one bit deeper.
R1_MEASURE_FROM_SCENE_LINEAR.assertion: FRAME_PROVENANCE_ASSERTION — before any axis is computed, the loaded frame must be floating point with >= 3 channels, and the loader refuses a uint8 array. Alpha is dropped explicitly, never averaged.
R1_MEASURE_FROM_SCENE_LINEAR.negative_control: hand the loader the existing 8-bit RGBA frame and require that it RAISES. A guard that cannot reject the artifact that caused the defect is not a guard.

R2_STIMULUS_REALIZATION_GATE.change: every fixture pair, in every study, computes a frame-level difference between its two members BEFORE any axis is evaluated. If the members are bit-identical, or differ by less than the declared realization floor, the pair reports STIMULUS_NOT_REALIZED and NO relative effect is recorded for it.

declared_floor.metric: rms difference over the measured region, normalised by the region mean of the low member
declared_floor.rationale: 0.2% of the region mean is roughly one part in 500 — below any structure the axes claim to resolve, and far above the zero produced by a deterministic re-render of identical input. It is a realization floor, NOT a pass bar, and it is never compared against 0.25.

R2_STIMULUS_REALIZATION_GATE.assertion: no axis result may be written for a pair whose stimulus did not realize. 'detects: false' becomes unreachable for an unrealized stimulus, which is the exact false conclusion drawn at 927ab8a.
R2_STIMULUS_REALIZATION_GATE.negative_control: an identical-spec pair must report STIMULUS_NOT_REALIZED, not 'no axis detects'.

R3_WITHDRAW_SURFACE_AUTOCORRELATION_MM.change: the axis is WITHDRAWN. It correlates a field that a 3x3 box high-pass has just whitened, so it reports its own kernel support (0.14 mm = 2 px) on every frame ever measured. It is not admitted, not repaired in place, and not counted toward any pair.
R3_WITHDRAW_SURFACE_AUTOCORRELATION_MM.replacement_status: NONE_DECLARED_YET. Grain SCALE remains an unmeasured quantity. No pair currently depends on it, so M6 is not blocked by its absence, and inventing a replacement inside a repair would be a new axis smuggled past its own declaration.
R3_WITHDRAW_SURFACE_AUTOCORRELATION_MM.assertion: SYNTHETIC_FIELD_CONTROL — any future scale axis must first recover a KNOWN correlation length from a synthetic field, within a declared tolerance, before it may look at a render.
R3_WITHDRAW_SURFACE_AUTOCORRELATION_MM.negative_control: the withdrawn axis fails that synthetic control. Recording that failure is what makes the withdrawal evidence rather than opinion.

R4_PER_AXIS_NOISE_FLOOR_BECOMES_A_PRECON.change: each axis acquires a MEASURED seed-only noise floor from a same-family, same-parameter, seed-varied ensemble. An axis whose noise floor is >= the 25% pass bar is INELIGIBLE to carry a pair, and an axis's clearing result must exceed its own floor by the declared separation margin.

declared_margin.meaning: a clearing effect must be at least 2x the axis's measured seed-only floor
declared_margin.rationale: EDGE_HIGHLIGHT_RESPONSE measured 0.27991 on seed alone and was counted as a clearing axis at 0.3604 — 1.29x its own noise. A factor of 2 is the smallest margin under which that result would not have been banked.

R4_PER_AXIS_NOISE_FLOOR_BECOMES_A_PRECON.explicitly_not: this does NOT raise the pass bar. The bar stays 0.25 for every axis. This adds an eligibility precondition on the INSTRUMENT, in the same spirit as enlarging the light source rather than lowering a threshold.
R4_PER_AXIS_NOISE_FLOOR_BECOMES_A_PRECON.assertion: the ensemble is computed and stored per axis; a ruling that uses an axis without a recorded floor raises.
R4_PER_AXIS_NOISE_FLOOR_BECOMES_A_PRECON.negative_control: re-running the ruling with EDGE_HIGHLIGHT_RESPONSE's measured floor must FLIP MATTE_vs_SATIN from PASS to FAIL. If it does not, this repair did nothing and the finding was wrong.

R5_INDEPENDENCE_BECOMES_MEASURED.change: axis independence stops being a prose claim. Over the family census, every axis pair gets a measured correlation. Two axes correlated above the declared ceiling may not BOTH count toward the same pair's 2-axis requirement; the pair must find its second clearing axis elsewhere.

declared_ceiling.metric: absolute Spearman rank correlation across the measured family census
declared_ceiling.rationale: declared before the correlations are computed. Four of the six lobe axes are the same scalar on different regions; whether that makes them redundant is an empirical question this measurement answers, not one the docstring may answer.

R5_INDEPENDENCE_BECOMES_MEASURED.explicitly_not: the law still requires 2 axes at 25%. This makes the word 'independent' in that law checkable instead of asserted.
R5_INDEPENDENCE_BECOMES_MEASURED.assertion: a ruling that counts two axes above the ceiling raises rather than passing.
R5_INDEPENDENCE_BECOMES_MEASURED.negative_control: an axis correlated with itself must be rejected by the ceiling — proving the check can fire.

R6_NO_SILENT_FALLBACK_VALUES.change: every degenerate branch that currently returns 0.0 raises instead. A region with a zero median, a variance below the numerical floor, or a correlation that never crosses its threshold within the search window is a refusal to measure, not a measurement of zero.
R6_NO_SILENT_FALLBACK_VALUES.assertion: the axis functions have no return path that produces a number the caller cannot distinguish from a real reading.
R6_NO_SILENT_FALLBACK_VALUES.negative_control: a black region must raise, and the test asserts the raise.

exit_conditions: every R1..R6 assertion exists and its negative control is recorded as having FAILED CORRECTLY — an assertion with no demonstrated failure mode does not count
the axis sensitivity study is re-run on the repaired instrument with the families UNCHANGED, and its record carries the frozen family identities to prove they did not move
the three diffuse pairs are re-ruled on the repaired instrument; whatever verdict results is recorded, PASS or FAIL
MATTE_vs_SATIN's prior PASS is explicitly re-adjudicated and the prior record is superseded in place rather than deleted
the GLITTER_PARTICLE_RIG census is re-measured from the EXR and its 87-event PASS is either confirmed or withdrawn
texture_axes_validation.json is regenerated; the stale FAIL is superseded with its reason recorded
the full canonical pytest suite passes, and the exit record is written externally with the git SHA pinned inside it — the suite does not verify itself
owner_approved remains false; this repair may not approve itself
not_established: that the six lobe axes are sufficient — only whether they are eligible and independent
